metadata.purpose: Hackathon fixtures; no real customers, transactions, policies, quotes, or merchant participation.

records.title: Return eligibility
records.text: Accept returns within 30 days for this fictional merchant. All seeded cases are 10 days after purchase.

records.title: Direct forwarding
records.text: A sealed returned item may go to a waiting buyer only when the SKU matches, the arrival meets the buyer deadline, and the merchant approves the current plan.

records.title: Opened items
records.text: An opened item must undergo inspection before resale. A broken seal blocks forwarding to a waiting buyer, even if the original return form said sealed.

records.title: Damaged items
records.text: A damaged item must not go directly to a waiting buyer. Route it to an approved inspection or warehouse destination, or a merchant-verified repair business.

records.title: Uncertain condition
records.text: If condition is unknown or contradictory, do not assume it is sealed. Request evidence or inspection before resale.

records.title: External destinations
records.text: A search result is only a candidate. The merchant must verify acceptance and costs before an external business becomes an actionable destination.

records.title: Approval and current facts
records.text: Approval applies only to the current case and policy version. New inspection facts or a policy change require a fresh review and approval.

records.title: Reservation limits
records.text: A returned item and a waiting order may each have only one active reservation. An expired reservation cannot support an approved shipment.
